title: tc-saved-search-alerts
description:
Saved searches that tell you about new matches – the new count, how often and where each checks, pause, Run now,
remove with Undo, and Add alert.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

alerts.description: The alerts, in order. Changed by the user unless tc-alerts-change is prevented

draftQuery.description: A query to fill Add alert with – the search the person just ran

now.description: The time now, epoch ms; by default the element's own clock

locale.description: The language for dates and numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

readonly.description: Read only: no adding, changing or removing

channels.description: Where it tells you: the ids of `channels`

newCount.description: How many new matches since it last told you

lastRun.description: When it last checked, epoch ms

lastMatch.description: When it last found something new, epoch ms – "12 new since Tue"
